import json

# Criteria from the definition, applied to each option:
# 1) the service recipient's resources are integrated into service delivery,
# 2) this jointly improves the service level with the provider,
# 3) both provider and recipient benefit (win-win).
options = {
    "A": {"recipient_resource_integrated": True,  "joint_service_improvement": True,  "win_win": True,
          "note": "Parents' labor is integrated into class cleaning; school saves cost."},
    "B": {"recipient_resource_integrated": True,  "joint_service_improvement": True,  "win_win": True,
          "note": "Customers' folding stools are integrated into the store's service; customers feel cared for and sales rise."},
    "C": {"recipient_resource_integrated": False, "joint_service_improvement": False, "win_win": False,
          "note": "Self-service by one person; no service provider and no integration into a service system."},
    "D": {"recipient_resource_integrated": False, "joint_service_improvement": False, "win_win": False,
          "note": "Incentive rewarding bag use for image; recipient resources are not integrated into service management."},
}

selected = [k for k in sorted(options)
            if options[k]["recipient_resource_integrated"]
            and options[k]["joint_service_improvement"]
            and options[k]["win_win"]]

if selected:
    result = {
        "final_answer": ", ".join(selected),
        "evidence": {k: options[k]["note"] for k in selected},
    }
else:
    result = {"final_answer": "UNSUPPORTED", "evidence": {}}

print(json.dumps(result, separators=(",", ":")))
